title: Crunchy Freekeh Salad with Zesty Vinaigrette
description: A refreshing salad featuring crunchy freekeh, zesty vinaigrette, and portuguese flavors. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Zesty Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade zesty olive oil

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: Use as a spice blend or make your own

instructions: Rinse the freekeh and cook according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the zesty olive oil, portuguese-style seasoning, salt, and tagine.
Add the cooked freekeh, red onion, cucumber, parsley, and almonds to the bowl.
Toss to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
